title: Wiserax Games: games I made with AI agents
description: Zombie Tower, GRAFT and NECRO: small, loud games I built with a crew of AI agents. Free, in your phone browser, no install.
kicker: Wiserax · games · made with AI agents
intro: Every game here was built by me and my agents with Wisecraft. Some were prototypes that never got a green light, so they respawn here, still playable. All of them run in a phone browser: no install, no login.

how.title: One human, a lot of agents
how.text: I direct, play and judge; agents write the code, draw the boards, run the bots and break my builds. Wisecraft is the studio kit that keeps them in line, and it's open source.

footer: Likes and comments need no account. Be nice, report the trolls.
